description: Fires when the opponent threatens to win at the landing cell of column 0 (the leftmost column), above all when they just played column 0 to make three of their stones stacked vertically there (act 20-57). A col-0 threat completed along the down-right diagonal, or a row-3+ horizontal, fires moderately. Col-0 threats on low horizontal rows or the up-right diagonal, my own col-0 wins, and threats in other columns give little or nothing.
effect: Pushes the model to play column 0 (block). Zeroing it at a vertical col-0 threat drops col 0 from 1.00 to 0.90, and in a mid-band position from 0.90 to 0.59; forcing it to max in a neutral opening raises col 0 by about +0.32.
notes: Scores: any col-0 must-block F1 0.526 (P .68 R .43); vertical+down-right diag F1 0.534 (P .91 R .38); +row>=3 horizontal +my col-0 win F1 0.549; graded final F1 0.548 P .85 R .40 AUROC .83. Minimal pairs: vertical O three in col0 ~30 vs col1 -0.1, col6 1.5; horizontal row-1 col-0 threat 0.0; up-right diag 0.0; down-right diag 16.7; the threat decays to 7-13 if other moves follow. About 60% of firing is weak (0.7-19) and diffuse (vertical threes elsewhere, col 0 the best move), which this rule misses. Sim share was nan (negative ceiling).
